summary_en: The caller, Kiran, initiated the call to inquire about the status of order ID FC10234, which had not yet arrived. The agent explained that live order status cannot be checked over the phone, but offered to note down the order ID so the support team could investigate and call back. Kiran provided his name, and the agent confirmed that both the name and order ID were recorded for the support team's follow-up. Kiran accepted this resolution by saying 'okay, thanks,' and the interaction concluded after a brief technical audio glitch where the agent asked Kiran to repeat himself, which Kiran did not do, ending the call.
next_action: Support team to check order status and call back the customer.
